results.details: v1.10 is an additive API extension of the v1.9 behavior-bound Run contract
the frozen operation set contains snapshot, evaluation, promotion, current channel and automatic rollback only
admin mutation requires signed session, owner/admin, CSRF and durable idempotency
admin mutation requires signed session, owner/admin, CSRF and durable idempotency
admin mutation requires signed session, owner/admin, CSRF and durable idempotency
promotion binds fresh reauthentication, dual control and serialized channel sequence
current channel is an authenticated non-cacheable profile/environment read
automatic rollback is isolated on an exact-SPIFFE internal listener with a purpose-bound signing key
all local schema refs resolve (none missing)
every named object rejects undeclared fields and declares every required property
all mutation envelopes are closed and bind a client request id
user, session, role, CSRF and automation identity can never be supplied in request envelopes
manifest binds every model-controlled component and source commit
evaluation evidence requires exactly two independently powered English and Chinese slices
evaluation report records every frozen zero-tolerance class
promotion request binds immutable candidate/baseline/evaluation evidence and exactly two approvals
rollout always carries observation and bounded automatic rollback thresholds
rollback request binds prior/target state, breached measurement, incident hash, key and signature
mutation response binds durable resource, event, hash and replay state
channel read returns the complete immutable deployment binding consumed by new Runs
event and idempotency response payloads are encrypted before object storage
control-plane failure modes map to the frozen public error catalog
v1.10 content root is anchored to the exact v1.9 amendment and contract file
